normative_semantic_constraints: All strings obey UTF-8 byte ceilings in addition to character counts; integers are strict nonboolean tokens, reduced rationals positive denominator, bounds checked before arithmetic.
Typed object bodies dispatch by exact reference role; lower Q/B require unchanged maintained public validators. Shape validity never establishes authority or gate permission.
Result/trace row order is exact; top-level raw/target arrays follow H_F then H_H, actions a0,aF,aH,aHF. Feasibility/actions likewise; no aliases.
Gate false iff four numerical payloads are blocked and all 21 descendants performed/computed false, values null, blocked reason exact, trace projection rows empty.

Raw ready iff interval present and trace effect states/corners populated; unknown/inapplicable has null interval/effects and empty corners. Observation unavailable implies null decimal/T0/IDs/checksum/unit and public unavailable reason; status equals disposition.

Selection selected iff nonnull bounded minimum and nonempty qualifying IDs in profile order; other dispositions have null minimum and empty IDs. Public current-condition combinations and refusal reasons retained without invention.

assessment.numeric_kind none iff numeric_value null; availability blocked iff gate-blocked row. Unavailable current match performed true computed false; assessed raw unknown performed true computed true but numeric_comparable false.

numeric_comparable requires prior, both evaluated, nonnull numeric values of same kind and matching units/cost identity; numeric_value_changed null otherwise. Typed value_changed retains separate existing meaning and null when not comparable.

Availability/status/diagnostic flags compare assessment components with prior even for blocked states; null without prior. Required reviews derive from dependency union and changed support, not flags. Any changed component requires a governing required review; no computed arithmetic inferred.

Physical charged = logical minimum + sum of per-scope positive excess work; savings never cancel another scope excess. Actual reported work <= charged in each unit; all charged <= effective policy. Extra work checked before next unit.

Physical observed=false stubs are preparation only and fail this runtime manifest schema. Replay compares exact result/trace plus deterministic accounting and validates historical/new work evidence separately.

Closure recipe lists sorted unique exact members; recursively recover each full canonical byte sequence and verify length/digest. Active cycles reject; opaque basis has no outgoing semantic edges. W/F hashes are checked by recomputing retained-source recipe, not trusted.

Technical errors emit no semantic R/rows; stderr <=512 including LF and exact existing diagnostic vocabulary/message_key rule. Retention failure emits no completion receipt. Published manifest last, no overwrite; all bytes including physical evidence count.

Per-file and aggregate byte/node ceilings apply before construction/append; output rows need fixed counted slots. No unknown nested keys except explicit content-addressed object maps and separately typed delegated payload bodies.
